Long Weekend Causes Massive Tourist Rush and Traffic Jams in Hill Stations

A massive influx of tourists and pilgrims descended upon popular hill stations including Manali, Mussoorie, Shimla, and the pilgrimage site Kainchi Dham during the long Gandhi Jayanti weekend. This surge in visitors led to significant traffic congestion on key routes and within the destinations in Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand.
